issue.title: Capture writes the mail note and final Gmail link from a fresh peek cache

task_type_fields.proposal: With a fresh `bob gmail peek` cache entry (the host-local, metadata-only cache under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/bob-cli/gmail/), `bob capture` could write the mail note and the final labelled link in its own capture batch instead of leaving the URL for the detached `bob gmail link` worker to swap about two seconds later.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Deferred by plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 (epic bob-cli-hg). The epic shipped invariant I2 (capture never touches the network) with the URL as its own placeholder plus a detached worker; writing notes from cache at submit changes that contract and needs its own design pass.

issue.creation_reason: Filed by the bob-cli-hg land agent: plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 lists this as a deferred follow-up to file once the Gmail epic lands.

payload.description: Deferred follow-up from the Gmail epic plan §6; builds on what bob-cli-hg shipped
